parameters.label: Intensity
parameters.description: Conservative output level for a neutral surface.

parameters.label: Residual trace
parameters.description: Visibility of prediction error in the contour field.

parameters.label: Field scale
parameters.description: Spatial scale of the membrane field.

parameters.label: Flow
parameters.description: Speed of the authored field drift.

parameters.label: Luminous body
parameters.description: Amount of surface body above black level.

parameters.label: Residual tint
parameters.description: Warm separation when observed and predicted states diverge.

parameters.label: Wave scale
parameters.description: Spatial scale of the caustic field.

parameters.label: Caustic contrast
parameters.description: Brightness of the intersecting light bands.

parameters.label: Depth
parameters.description: Dark body between the caustic highlights.

parameters.label: Flame scale
parameters.description: Spatial scale of the flame field.

parameters.label: Rise
parameters.description: Vertical travel of the fire field.

parameters.label: Break threshold
parameters.description: Amount of residual required before fracture appears.

parameters.label: Separation
parameters.description: Distance between predicted and observed visual strata.

parameters.label: Recovery
parameters.description: Rate at which the field reorganises after a peak.

parameters.label: Drift
parameters.description: Motion of traces around the observed envelope.

parameters.label: Coverage
parameters.description: Fraction of surface carrying the grid.

parameters.label: Scan
parameters.description: Moving scan detail across the predicted body.

parameters.label: Offset
parameters.description: Visual separation from the observed body.

parameters.label: Line width
parameters.description: Width of the diagnostic wire lines.

parameters.label: Distortion
parameters.description: Organic displacement of the regular cells.

parameters.label: Viscosity
parameters.description: Roundness and drag of each fold.

parameters.label: Contrast
parameters.description: Separation of active and resting cells.

parameters.label: Cell scale
parameters.description: Number of cells across the sphere.

parameters.label: Rotation
parameters.description: Slow turn of the internal facet field.

parameters.label: Growth
parameters.description: Rate at which the field opens.

parameters.label: Wave speed
parameters.description: Travel speed of the wave fronts.

parameters.label: Ocean depth
parameters.description: Darkness and colour depth between crests.

parameters.label: Field strength
parameters.description: Contrast and reach of each line.

parameters.label: Line frequency
parameters.description: Density of the two line fields.

parameters.label: Field rotation
parameters.description: Relative rotation of the interference layers.

parameters.label: Interference
parameters.description: Separation between primary and secondary fields.

parameters.label: Frost coverage
parameters.description: Amount of surface overtaken by frost.

parameters.label: Thread contrast
parameters.description: Separation of fibres from the dark body.

parameters.label: Erosion
parameters.description: Breakup and pooling along the levels.

parameters.label: Scan speed
parameters.description: Travel speed of the holographic scan.

parameters.label: Tunnel scale
parameters.description: Spacing of the rushing tunnel rings.

parameters.label: Flight speed
parameters.description: Rate at which the tunnel advances.

parameters.label: Depth
parameters.description: Contrast between the tunnel mouth and outer field.

parameters.label: Fold speed
parameters.description: Rate at which the symmetry field evolves.

parameters.label: Warp
parameters.description: Distortion applied before the symmetry fold.

parameters.label: Circuit scale
parameters.description: Scale of the recursive circuit field.

parameters.label: Line width
parameters.description: Width of the luminous circuit paths.

parameters.label: Core size
parameters.description: Angular size of the dark core.

parameters.label: Ring width
parameters.description: Thickness of the luminous lensing ring.

parameters.label: Lensing
parameters.description: Amount of warped structure around the core.

parameters.label: Ring density
parameters.description: Number of hoops crossing the sphere.

parameters.label: Ring speed
parameters.description: Rate at which the hoops travel.

parameters.label: Crossing set
parameters.description: Strength of the second ring axis.

parameters.label: Tile scale
parameters.description: Number of curved tiles across the surface.

parameters.label: Tile drift
parameters.description: Rate at which the tile field moves.

parameters.label: Arc width
parameters.description: Width of the curved tile paths.

parameters.label: Twist
parameters.description: Rotation and irregularity of each projection.
